feature: product-assisted perception: one-tap target selection (TargetSeed → locked TargetIdentity)
identityDesign: Seed resolves ONE person in the first ~1.2s, then identity follows that person; court half never re-decides identity. Duplicate detections of the same human are absorbed as ALIASES (never opponents), and the best-covered alias is promoted as the base track.

aliasesAbsorbed.afn-sasebo-rally1: P9, P13, P2 folded into P1 (were previously competing 'other players')

contact.auto: n=5, median 66ms, 3/4 within 2 frames, dink ABSTAINED
contact.userTap: n=5, median 66ms, 3/4 within 2 frames, dink RECOVERED to 1407ms ball+paddle-confirmed

honestConclusion: The tap materially improves IDENTITY (confidence 0.30→0.94 on held-out; alias poisoning eliminated) and recovers downstream quality (held-out dink contact un-abstained and became ball+paddle-confirmed; stroke L2 2/4 → 3/4). It does NOT move the paddle waterfall, because the S3 loss is not 'wrong person selected' — it is selection among many paddle tracklets belonging to the RIGHT person. Product-assisted perception fixed the problem it addresses; it did not fix the one it does not.
